name: Image-Centric Volume Rendering with SN-SVM Classification
definition: An image-centric volume rendering method where the user interacts directly with grayscale volume slices to select voxels, which are then classified using an SN-SVM classifier and assigned colors/opacity via color harmonization.
summary: Image-Centric Volume Rendering uses user-defined 2D slice training data for SN-SVM classification to automatically label voxels and assign colors, avoiding pre-processing to preserve raw data granularity.
